name: YNH Property Bhd
overview: 2026年，YNH Property 提议以 RM455,000,000 出售吉隆坡一幅永久商业发展地皮，交易对价以现金、Chin Hin Property (JSI) 的可赎回优先股及普通股支付；同时，全资子公司 YNH Construction 与 LHDN 就未缴税款达成和解，清盘呈请将撤回。集团全年营收由 393.58 百万令吉降至 106.87 百万令吉，最新一季营收同比下滑 81.5%。
overview_en: In 2026, YNH Property proposed to dispose of a freehold commercial development land in Kuala Lumpur for RM455,000,000, to be satisfied by cash, redeemable preference shares and ordinary shares in Chin Hin Property (JSI); meanwhile, wholly-owned subsidiary YNH Construction reached a settlement with LHDN and the winding-up petition will be withdrawn. Full-year revenue fell from RM393.58 million to RM106.87 million, with the latest quarter's revenue down 81.5% year-on-year.

segments.name: 物业发展
segments.note: 今年提议出售吉隆坡一幅商业发展地皮，交易对价包括现金及 Chin Hin Property (JSI) 的优先股和普通股。
segments.note_en: This year, proposed the disposal of a commercial development land parcel in Kuala Lumpur, with consideration comprising cash and preference and ordinary shares in Chin Hin Property (JSI).

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司就上述出售事项提供额外资料。
actions.text_en: The Company provided additional information on the proposed disposal.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: YNH Land Sdn. Bhd. 提议以 RM455,000,000 出售吉隆坡 Lot 20002 一幅永久商业发展地皮予 Chin Hin Property (JSI) Sdn. Bhd.，对价以现金、455,000 股可赎回优先股及 25,000 股普通股支付。
actions.text_en: YNH Land Sdn. Bhd. proposed to dispose of a freehold commercial development land parcel, Lot 20002 in Kuala Lumpur, to Chin Hin Property (JSI) Sdn. Bhd. for RM455,000,000, satisfied by cash, 455,000 redeemable preference shares and 25,000 ordinary shares.

segments.name: 建筑
segments.note: 全资子公司 YNH Construction 与 LHDN 就未缴税款达成和解，清盘呈请将撤回。

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: YNH Construction 与 LHDN 达成和解，LHDN 于 2026 年 10 月 23 日函件确认将撤回清盘呈请。
actions.text_en: YNH Construction reached an amicable settlement with LHDN, which confirmed by letter dated 23 October 2026 that the winding-up petition will be withdrawn.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 2026 年 7 月 16 日听证会未对 YNH Construction 作出清盘令，LHDN 于 7 月 23 日书面批准修订后的和解安排，未缴税款 RM5,155,601.09 须于 2026 年 9 月 10 日前结清。
actions.text_en: No winding-up order was made against YNH Construction at the 16 July 2026 hearing;

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: YNH Construction 因未缴税款 RM7,210,064.77 遭 LHDN 提出清盘呈请，听证会定于 2026 年 7 月 16 日。
